_comment: LOCAL ONLY — nothing here can reach a cloud provider.
The openrouter backend is deliberately ABSENT rather than merely unrouted:
the router resolves backends by name, so with none defined there is nothing
for a stray 'openrouter/...' candidate to resolve to, and claude/scripts/
local_audit.py hard-refuses to run if it finds a non-ollama backend here.
Replace every model name below with tags you actually have installed.
Run `python3 ~/.claude/scripts/probe_models.py` first — it tests your models
and prints a snippet naming the ones that work. A wrong tag fails at call
time with a 404, not at startup.

grading._comment: Grading is real GPU work now, not a free cloud tier. Every graded call costs a second inference, so sample rather than grading everything.

swarm._comment: review_dimensions drives both local_review_diff and the /local-audit sweeper. Two DIFFERENT models matter more than two strong ones: uncorrelated mistakes are what makes agreement meaningful. concurrency.ollama should match OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL on the server.

adaptive._comment: Scores are keyed by model NAME. Renaming or replacing a model orphans its history and each new candidate restarts from zero samples.
